meta.description: 8:30pm IST. One fact, one ask, to advisor + parent via ClickUp. Never invents a chapter stage.

parameters.query:
select a.id as alcovian_id, a.name, a.academic_advisor,
  count(t.id) filter (where t.due_on < current_date and t.completed_at is null) as overdue,
  bool_or(r.syllabus_on_track = false) as syllabus_behind
from alcovians a
left join tasks t on t.alcovian_id = a.id
left join advisor_monthly_reviews r on r.alcovian_id = a.id
  and r.month = date_trunc('month', current_date)
group by a.id, a.name, a.academic_advisor
having count(t.id) filter (where t.due_on < current_date and t.completed_at is null) > 0
    or bool_or(r.syllabus_on_track = false);

insert into nudges_sent (alcovian_id, trigger, channel, sent_at)
values ($1::uuid, $2, 'clickup', now());
